scope:
Apply the recorded CFD wall motion to a UVLM model at the same initial pose.

CFD explicit Fluid-first coupling uses the previous accepted structural q.
Replay that wall path with linear interpolation and interval-constant velocity;
this is a prescribed aerodynamic comparison, not another free response.
limitations: Different viscous/closed-surface versus inviscid/camber-surface physics and spatial discretizations. Both use the CFD initial pose and replayed wall motion. UVLM is linearized, fixed wake, 40-state ROM; see frequency-domain reduction checks. A nonperiodic release work integral is not a periodic damping coefficient.
